Market today:
The market is showing mixed signals. The S&P 500 hit a new high, but a "Big Short" investor warns of a potential crash. More critically for you, tech and chip names like SpaceX and AMD are seeing significant drops, even after positive news, due to concerns around AI spending and high expectations.

Your holdings:
SOXL (-45.03%) and SPAL (-47.87%) are your most pressing concerns. Both are leveraged ETFs, meaning they decay over time and their losses are amplified by margin. Their current stop levels are far from relevant. SMH is also down (-9.53%).

Watch:
Keep a close eye on how AI spending concerns continue to impact the broader tech and chip sector. Also, monitor the general market sentiment given the S&P 500's new high and the warning of a potential correction.

Bottom line:
Prioritize risk management in your leveraged tech/chip positions, especially with sector volatility and broader market warnings.
plays: Re-evaluate stops for SOXL and SPAL immediately. Their current stops are irrelevant given deep losses and leveraged decay.
Consider trimming SOXL and SPAL to reduce leveraged exposure. The AMD news highlights sector risk, amplifying your current losses.
No new buys today. The tech/chip sector is showing weakness despite some positive news, making new long entries risky.
